hooks.name: Visual Style Compliance Check
hooks.description: When a UI file is saved, asks Kiro to review it against the visual-style steering file and report any violations concisely. Covers components, app pages, CSS, and Tailwind config.

action.prompt: A UI file was just saved. Review it against .kiro/steering/visual-style.md and report any violations concisely. Check for: non-palette hex values or Tailwind default colors (e.g. blue-500), missing `pixel-art` CSS class on sprite elements, spring physics in Framer Motion (forbidden), missing `useReducedMotion()` guard on animated components, `outline: none` without a focus-visible replacement, missing `alt` text on sprites, font usage other than Press Start 2P, font sizes below 8px, StatBars that convey state through color alone without a text label. List each violation as a short bullet with the line number. If there are no violations, say 'Visual style: ✅ no violations found.'
